'''InQuest''' was Wizard Press's collectible-card-game [[Magazines|magazine]]. Issue 22 (February 1997) printed [[Michael Mikaelian]]'s special report [[Star Wars World Championships (InQuest)]] on the [[1996 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="inquest">Michael Mikaelian, "Star Wars World Championships", ''InQuest'' #22 (February 1997), p. 14. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/inquest-magazine-issue-22 InQuest Magazine Issue 22], Internet Archive.</ref>

Issue 20 (December 1996) printed Mikaelian's Killer Decks II list [[Michael Mikaelian Yavin 4 Counterstrike|Yavin 4 Counterstrike]] on pages 38–39.<ref name="inquest20">Michael Mikaelian, "Killer Decks II", ''InQuest'' #20 (December 1996), pp. 38–39. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/inquest-20 InQuest #20], Internet Archive.</ref> Issue 38 (June 1998) included a [[Force Playmat]] insert.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=185 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 185. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> Issue 14 (June 1996) printed [[Myles S. Hildebrand]]'s [[Basic training (InQuest)|Basic training]].<ref name="wp-swccg">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game Star Wars Customizable Card Game], Wikipedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016121021/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game Internet Archive]</ref> Issue 39 (July 1998) printed [[Mirror, Mirror (InQuest)|Mirror, Mirror]] by Mikaelian and [[Jason Robinette]], and [[Jabba's Palace (InQuest)]] by Robinette.<ref name="wook-39">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/InQuest_39 InQuest 39], Wookieepedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20251112204442/https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/InQuest_39 Internet Archive]</ref> Issue 43 (November 1998) printed [[Sith Element]] by Mikaelian and [[George Strayton]].<ref name="tfn-iq">[https://www.theforce.net/rpg/magazines/mags-inquestgamer.asp Unofficial Mag Articles – Inquest Gamer], TheForce.Net. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190811165154/http://www.theforce.net/rpg/magazines/mags-inquestgamer.asp Internet Archive]</ref> Issue 49 (May 1999) printed [[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace CCGs]] by [[Heath Scheiman]] and [[The Emperor's Hand (InQuest)|The Emperor's Hand]] by [[Jerry Fredricks]]. Issue 79 (November 2001) listed [[Best buys: Star Wars CCG: Coruscant]].<ref name="wp-swccg" /> The dated catalog is [[Magazines]].
